verdict.rationale: BugSnag offers an official MCP server (SmartBear MCP, with OAuth support) and a documented Data Access API. The API has an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec plus pagination, auth and rate-limit docs, so an agent can programmatically pull errors from production. Triage concepts (error statuses, open/new filters, automated assignment rules) and a Jira/issue-tracker integration exist for filing bugs. However, the evidence does not show that the MCP tools or API expose full stack traces, or that an agent can set triage status or file tracker issues through API/MCP rather than the dashboard integration. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool list covering issue/stack-trace retrieval, API/MCP-driven triage and issue-creation endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
